elements.texte:
[cheerful] At the medical practice, each doctor prints the list of their patients for the day.

For each appointment, we need the patient’s name and their doctor’s name.

We get the patient’s name from the appointments table.

We get their doctor’s name from the doctors table.

Sarah Lopez’s appointment doesn’t have a doctor yet, and Dr Anne Roux has no appointments.

Your turn!

Doctor underscore ID holds the doctor’s ID: it matches doctors dot ID.

Your turn!

Inner join only keeps the rows that have a match on both sides.

[cheerful] Every morning, at the aquarium, the keeper goes round every tank.

The Abyss is empty while it’s being cleaned, and the turtle, cared for in quarantine, has no tank.
